subject: Waste Hauler Ordinance Updates
overview: The subcommittee met to discuss proposed updates to the city's waste hauler ordinance (Paper 22-605) in alignment with MassDEP standards and an upcoming waste contract RFP. The committee approved four motions to gather consultant and vendor feedback, coordinate department regulations, and strengthen recycling requirements in the draft ordinance.

items.title: Proposed Waste Hauler Ordinance (Paper 22-605)
items.summary: The committee discussed revising Chapter 70 to mandate bundled trash and recycling services and approved motions to obtain solid waste consultant and vendor review, coordinate with city departments on Board of Health regulations, and require all permitted haulers to collect recyclables.
